NOTES TO THE INTERIM FINANCIAL STATEMENTS


1   The interim financial statements have been prepared in accordance with Sri Lanka Accounting Standard - LKAS 34 Interim Financial Reporting.
    There are no changes to the Accounting Polices and methods of computation since the publication of Financial Statements for the year ended 31st
    March 2026.

2   The Company has commitments for acquisition of property, plant and equipment incidental to the ordinary course of business as at 30 June 2026
    are as follows:

4   There have been no significant Contingent Assets or Contingent Liabilities as at the Reporting date which require disclosures in the interim Financial Statements.



5   The number of shares in issue of the Company as at 30 June 2026 is 950,086,080 (As at 30 June 2025 - 950,086,080).


6   Percentage of Public holding as at 30 June 2026 was 21.24% (As at 30 June 2025-21.22%) & total No. of Shareholders who holds the Public Holding as at 30 June 2026 -
    11,285 (As at 30 June 2025 - 11,003).


7   The float adjusted market capitalization as at 30 June 2026 was Rs.11,403,693,490.The Float adjusted market capitalization of the Company falls under Option 1
    of Rule 7.13.1 (i) (a) of the Listing Rules of the Colombo Stock Exchange and the Company has complied with the minimum public holding requirement applicable
    under the said option.


8   There have been no material events occurred after the reporting date that require adjustments to or disclosure in the financial statements, except the
    Board of Directors of the company has proposed the First & Final dividend of Rs.2.98 per share for the financial year ended 31 March 2026 for amounting
    to Rs.2,831,256,518/- as its board meeting held on 21st May 2026. It has been approved by shareholders at 71st Annual General Meeting held on 24th
    July 2026.
